final: WITH teams AS (SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team), team_stats AS (SELECT t.team_id, AVG(1.0 * mh.w / NULLIF(mh.g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(mh.team_id) AS record_count FROM teams AS t LEFT JOIN manager_half AS mh ON mh.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_win_rate FROM team_stats) SELECT s.team_id, s.avg_win_rate, s.record_count, s.avg_win_rate - o.mean_win_rate AS difference_from_mean FROM team_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_win_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
